takeaways.text: Revenue growth hit 78%, powered by advertising (+84%) as daily users reached 110.4M, up 21% — more people, spending more time, in more communities Reddit can sell ads against.
takeaways.title: Growth accelerated

takeaways.text: Net income was $89M, versus a $10M loss a year ago. Operating income swung from a $31M loss to a $68M profit, because revenue grew far faster than costs.
takeaways.title: A year-ago loss became a profit

takeaways.text: Operating cash flow was $111M, up from $28M a year ago — the profit is turning into cash, not just accounting gains.
takeaways.title: Cash flow followed

verdict: Reddit's revenue grew 78% to $500M as ad sales jumped 84% — and the young public company turned solidly profitable, with net income of $89M, 18 cents of every revenue dollar.
